trajectory.patch:
The error log indicates a test failure in the `retained_mem_api` test suite on the `qemu_cortex_m3` board. The failing assertion shows that data written to retained memory could not be read back correctly. This suggests an issue with the memory address being used for the retained memory region.

Looking at the device tree overlay for `qemu_cortex_m3` in `tests/drivers/retained_mem/api/boards/qemu_cortex_m3.overlay`, the `sram@2000ffe0` node defines the retained memory region. The `reg` property of this node is set to `<0x20010000 0x20>`, which is an address outside the available 64KB SRAM of the emulated `ti_lm3s6965` SoC (SRAM is from `0x20000000` to `0x2000FFFF`).

The node name `sram@2000ffe0` and the `ranges` property `<0x0 0x2000ffe0 0x20>` both indicate that the intended address for this memory region is `0x2000ffe0`. The `reg` property is incorrect and causes the driver to write to an invalid memory location, leading to the test failure.

The fix is to correct the `reg` property to use the address `0x2000ffe0`.

tests/drivers/retained_mem/api/boards/qemu_cortex_m3.overlay
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
		reg = <0x20010000 0x20>;
========
		reg = <0x2000ffe0 0x20>;
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
